body.message:
Good morning, and Jummah Mubarak. Thank you for your update, and no worries regarding the Downtown Views unit.

I’m looking for a clean, modern, and preferably new apartment in JVC, either a 1-bedroom or 2-bedroom, depending on the available options and price.

My preferred move-in date is at the beginning of next month, and I’m looking for a longer stay. I would also prefer flexible payment terms, ideally monthly if available.

Please feel free to share the best suitable options you currently have. Thank you for your help.
